claims.statement: Shared required vectors produce the same complete semantic result as lokalized-java 3.1.0 under the pinned data and reference-runtime versions. (Was 3.0.0; the maintainer's decision of 2026-09-20 sets the parity target to 3.1.0, and the recorded corpus has been 3.1.0-SNAPSHOT's since M-R S12. 3.1.0 was released on 2026-09-26, tag 3.1.0 at commit 63b63e4.)
Rendering-sensitive locale and plural behavior uses pinned generated data and does not depend on host ICU or Intl data.

The supported surfaces are ESM on Node 20+, browsers COMPILED for the named floors (Safari 16.4, Chrome 111, Firefox 111) and EXECUTED on one current engine, bundlers, and direct browser modules through only the declared package entry points. (Amendment A23, 2026-09-20: the claim was 'the named exact-floor browsers', which read as executed-at-the-floors and never was.)
The strict package includes the declared parsing, interpolation, bidi, expression, language-form, generated-placeholder, exact-numeric, plural, fallback, result, failure, and direct-locale behaviors.
The release includes explicit manifest planning, browser and Node loading, SSR identity, and the declared no-build browser distribution.
The release includes pinned server and edge RFC 4647 and Accept-Language negotiation, while root exposes only the strict single-locale kernel and explicitly non-parity small chooser.

The release publishes npm and direct-browser artifacts, declarations, language-neutral source artifacts, documentation, and an embedded parity declaration under the declared reproducibility and provenance rules.

Formatting, React/ecosystem integrations, TMS/XLIFF, hidden lookup I/O, mutable live reload, runtime-limit customization, and strict parity for host-Intl adapters are excluded or deferred exactly as listed.
